title: What are the delivery charges
content: Orders of ¥10,000 or more get FREE delivery (except Okinawa/沖縄県). Below that, a flat shipping charge of ¥1,200 applies.

title: Which areas do you deliver to
content: We deliver across Japan through our cold-chain partners. Enter your post code in the checkout to see your delivery schedule. If your post code is not listed, contact support and we will try to arrange it.

title: How long does delivery take
content: Delivery usually takes 2-4 days depending on your area and the delivery schedule. You can pick a preferred delivery date and time window (e.g. 09:00-12:00) during checkout.

title: Can I choose a delivery date and time
content: Yes. During checkout you can select your preferred delivery date and a time window such as 09:00-12:00, 12:00-15:00, 15:00-18:00, or 19:00-21:00.

title: How is fresh meat kept fresh during delivery
content: All fresh meat and fish is vacuum-packed and shipped in insulated cold-chain boxes with ice packs so it arrives refrigerated, never frozen-thawed multiple times.

title: What payment methods do you accept
content: We accept Cash on Delivery (COD) and online card payments via Stripe.

title: Is Cash on Delivery available
content: Yes. Pay cash when the driver delivers your order. Your order may show as Unpaid/Pending until the driver collects the cash — this is normal, not a problem.

title: How do refunds work for cash-on-delivery orders
content: Refunds for COD orders are issued as points in your account. Points can be used for future purchases (1 point = 1 yen).

title: How are card refunds processed
content: Card payments that already went through cannot be refunded manually. If a card payment failed, your points/wallet may hold a refund value. Contact support for card refund cases.

title: How do I return or raise a claim for a wrong or missing item
content: Tell Piku what was wrong (missing, damaged, or a different item) with your order number. Piku will register an order claim and our team will review and arrange a refund or replacement.

title: Are all products halal-certified
content: Yes. Every meat item we stock is 100% halal, and we verify supplier halal certification before we onboard any meat brand.

title: Do you sell alcohol or pork
content: No. We are a 100% halal store. We do not sell alcohol, pork, or any other non-halal products.

title: What is the shelf life of products
content: Expiry dates are printed on every pack. We follow first-expire-first-out and never ship items close to or past their expiry date.

title: How do I create an account
content: Open the login form and register with your name, phone, email and a password. You can also connect: social login may be available on the site.

title: How do I reset my password
content: Open the login page and click Forgot Password. Enter your account email and follow the reset link sent to you.

title: I cannot log in to my account
content: If login fails, first try the Forgot Password flow. If there is no email from us, check spam. Still stuck? Ask Piku to create a support ticket and our team will help you.

title: How do I change my account password
content: Log in, open My Account / Profile, then select Change Password. If you cannot access your account, use Forgot Password instead.

title: Where do you source your products from
content: We import directly from trusted halal-certified manufacturers in Bangladesh, Pakistan, India, and other South Asian countries, plus fresh local suppliers for meat and fish.

title: Do I get loyalty points on my orders
content: Yes. You earn points on eligible purchases that you can use like money on future orders (1 point = 1 yen). Piku can tell you your current point balance.

title: How do I use my loyalty points
content: During checkout you will see your available points. Slide the 'Use points' control to apply them to your order total.

title: What does 'Pending' order status mean
content: Pending means we received your order and it is reserved before processing. Pending orders can be changed or cancelled — ask Piku to change the date/time or cancel it.

title: What does 'Payment Pending' or 'Unpaid' mean
content: For Cash on Delivery, Unpaid is normal until the driver collects the cash. For card orders, Payment Failed means the payment did not go through and you can retry payment on the site.

title: Can I change my order after placing it
content: Yes — while your order is still Pending. Tell Piku the order number and you can change the delivery date/time or cancel it (login required or the email used on the order).

title: How do I track my delivery
content: Ask Piku your order number, or open the site's Order History for tracking updates. Once the parcel is with our delivery partner, the tracking timeline updates there.

title: How do I contact support
content: Chat with Piku any time — Piku can create a support ticket for you, and our team will get back to you. You can also email us directly.

title: Are product prices including tax
content: Prices shown exclude the 8% consumption tax; an 8% tax is added at checkout along with the shipping charge (free above ¥10,000 outside Okinawa).

title: Something arrived damaged. What do I do
content: Send Piku a photo of the damaged item with your order number. Piku will create a claim, and our team will arrange a refund or replacement quickly.

title: Do you have same-day or express delivery
content: Standard is 2-4 days. Some prefectures have fast schedules — enter your post code to see your area's available delivery slots.

title: My card payment failed but money was taken
content: Failed card payments that still show a charge may auto-reverse in a few days. If not, send Piku the payment receipt and it will create a ticket for our billing team.
